Specification: This module is a TLC-oriented wrapper around the ACP_SB specification, extending the underlying protocol module and TLC. It defines a symmetry-related helper operator using permutations of the participants, and rewrites the AC4 property into an explicit stuttering-invariant temporal formula over the participant variable. It also states a liveness-style property requiring that every participant eventually reaches either the commit or abort decision state.
TemporalSubscript:
[][ /\ (\A i \in participants : participant[i].decision = commit 
                                => (participant'[i].decision = commit))
               /\ (\A j \in participants : participant[j].decision = abort  
                                => (participant'[j].decision = abort))]_<<participant>>
